info.title: Cartesia Realtime Speech-to-Text WebSocket API
info.description:
Realtime speech transcription without turn detection

<Note>
  This endpoint relies on the `finalize` command to trigger transcription. See [Compare STT Endpoints](/use-the-api/stt/compare-endpoints) for details.
</Note>

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the audio in Hz.

language.description:
Used by `ink-whisper` models only.

The language of the input audio in ISO-639-1 format. Defaults to `en`.

See [Older models](/build-with-cartesia/stt/older-models#ink-whisper) for all options.

min_volume.description:
Used by `ink-whisper` models only.

Controls what is considered silence for automatic transcript finalization. Range: 0.0-1.0.

Lower values will pick up quiet audio.
Higher values lead to more filtering for noisy audio.

max_silence_duration_secs.description:
Used by `ink-whisper` models only.

Maximum duration of silence (in seconds) before the API automatically finalizes the transcript.

Lower values will finalize transcripts more aggressively.
Higher values allow for longer pauses within utterances.

keyterm.description:
Used by `ink-2` and `ink-preview` only.

Key terms to improve the recall of specific words and phrases.

Repeat the `keyterm` query parameter to pass multiple values, up to 100 keyterms totaling 1200 characters. To boost one multi-word phrase, join the words with `%20`.

Example: `?keyterm=Ink%202&keyterm=Cartesia`

See [Keyterm prompting](/use-the-api/stt/keyterms) for details.

STTAudioData.name: STTAudioData
STTAudioData.title: Send Audio Data
STTAudioData.description:
Send WebSocket binary messages containing raw audio data as specified by the `encoding` and `sample_rate` query parameters.

Audio Requirements:
- Send audio in small chunks, e.g. 100 ms
- Audio format must match the `encoding` and `sample_rate` parameters

STTFinalizeCommand.name: STTFinalizeCommand
STTFinalizeCommand.title: Finalize Command
STTFinalizeCommand.description: Send `finalize` as a text message when the user is done speaking to receive the transcript for any buffered audio.

STTCloseCommand.name: STTCloseCommand
STTCloseCommand.title: Close Command
STTCloseCommand.description: Send `close` as a text message to flush remaining audio, close session, and receive a done acknowledgment

STTTranscriptResponse.title: Transcript Response

STTErrorResponse.title: Error Response
STTErrorResponse.description: Error information for STT WebSocket connections.

STTAudioData.description: Raw audio data as a binary message in the format specified by the `encoding` parameter. Send audio in small chunks, e.g. 100 ms.

STTFinalizeCommand.description: The value `finalize` as a text message

STTCloseCommand.description: The value `close` as a text message

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this WebSocket connection.

text.description:
Transcribed text. This is a delta from the last transcript chunk with `"is_final": true`.

To assemble the full transcript, concatenate all transcript chunks where `"is_final": true`.

Do not strip whitespace from `text` or add whitespace between chunks as this will produce an incorrect transcript.

SpeechToTextModel.description:
ID of the model to use for transcription.

See [Models](/build-with-cartesia/stt/latest) for details.

SpeechToTextEncoding.description:
The encoding format of the audio data. This determines how the server interprets the raw binary audio data you send.

For guidance on choosing an encoding, see [Audio Input](/build-with-cartesia/stt/audio-input).
